page.overview:
What is Silver Dagger?

The is a dagger bestowed by Flora and Schierke to Farnese to help her in the fight against the trolls raiding Enoch Village.

The dagger is short, perhaps a foot or less in total length, and ornate. The rain-guard and crossguard are intricate and curled in a W-style. The grip has a similar double-helix design leading down to a pommel, which resembles a crescent moon.

Although it has no magical might on its own, silver possesses potent protective powers against evil beings.

Before returning to Vandimion household, Farnese sends her coat and dagger back to Schierke as a sign of her intention to stay home and convince her rich father to give Guts a ship with which to search for Skellig island. They are returned to her when Farnese decides to continue her journey with the Black Swordsman.
